d: Immerse yourself in a relaxing journey through stunning starscapes, showcasing the vastness of the cosmos with breathtaking views of galaxies, nebulae, and constellations. Paired with soothing ambient music, this 1-hour film offers a peaceful escape into the beauty of the universe.

Cosmic Relaxation, ambient journey through the universe with visuals of galaxies, nebulas, and planets from NASA's Hubble telescope. Paired with calming music by The Cynic Project and Deep. Ohm, it blends scenes from "Deep Space Relaxation" and "Celestial Relaxation" for all-day tranquility.
